entries.38dee99829c702b2: The company operates a nationwide chain of shoe specialty stores, engages in retail and wholesale of shoes, and earns its income from the sale of products.
entries.3b0cbf0f111398bb: It offers private-brand products that combine function and design, such as Sedakuresuto utility sneakers, Haidoroteku multifunctional business shoes and Spat Shoes, and also carries a lineup of low-priced products such as ¥1,990 sneakers and ¥450 indoor shoes. Spat Shoes have reached cumulative sales of 5,000,000 pairs.

entries.3df842121a05e44d: Under its medium-term management plan “Change,” the company is expanding private-brand products, promoting store- and format-specific strategies, strengthening digital promotion and advancing OMO, expanding sales channels, improving operational efficiency, and putting sustainability management into practice.
entries.471ca6f9bfe57652: It sells shoes at its Shoe Plaza Chiyoda, Tokyo Kutsu Ryutsu Center and Shoes Palletta stores and through its official online shop “kutsu.com.” The number of stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 863.

entries.59b4af0f1ddce15b: The company engages in shoe retail through its stores under the names Shūpuraza Chiyoda, Tōkyō Kutsu Ryūtsū Sentā and Shūzu Paretta, and its official online shop "kutsu.com". The number of stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 863.
entries.5b0df9f18eec0350: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥81,377 million. Sales by region were ¥35,919 million in the Kanto region, ¥13,546 million in the Hokkaido/Tohoku region, ¥11,939 million in the Chubu region, ¥8,164 million in the Kyushu/Okinawa region, ¥7,248 million in the Kinki region, ¥2,674 million in the Chugoku region and ¥1,886 million in the Shikoku region. No single customer accounted for 10% or more of revenue, and sales to external customers in Japan exceeded 90% of total revenue.
